company.name: Bajaj Finance
company.tag: A lender that is not a bank: instalment loans in shops, personal, gold and business loans
products: Loans to buy phones, TVs, fridges and furniture in shops and online (consumer lending)
Insta EMI Card for paying for purchases in monthly instalments
New car, used car, tractor and commercial-vehicle loans
Personal loans for salaried people and existing customers
Business loans for small firms and professionals such as doctors
Loans against property and equipment loans
Rural loans and microfinance group loans
Loans against shares, mutual funds and insurance policies
company.productNote: The eleven product groups named in the 2025–26 annual report’s management discussion, plus the two subsidiaries it lists. Bajaj Finance is itself a subsidiary of Bajaj Finserv, which is a separate listed company.
